correctness.rationale: Decompose each principal symmetric matrix by the distinguished antisymmetric vector, the unmarked sum-zero subspace, and the 2x2 block [[t,k],[2,k-1]]. For t!=0, singularity occurs precisely when t(k-1)=2k, with corank one and binom(d-2,k) such subsets. The singular projective quadric of rank r has Euler characteristic s-1+1_{r even}, with s=1 handled separately. Inclusion-exclusion on the coordinate torus changes (-1)^d chi(Q cap T) by -1 for each corank-one subset. Generic ML degree is Eulerian 2^(d-1)-d by the established toric generic-degree theorem. Independent exact SymPy rational ranks and alternating Euler sums corroborate d=4..7 at six generic/exception scalings; not a proof for unbounded d.
